Traffic Flow Forecasting

Predictive models comparing LSTM, XGBoost, ARIMA, and Prophet for vehicular traffic-flow prediction.

Time-SeriesLSTMProphet

Overview

Research work at IASBS comparing four forecasting approaches on vehicular traffic-flow data, to see which handled the sharp, recurring peaks of rush-hour traffic best.

Comparison

Model MAE Handles seasonality
ARIMA moderate manually specified
Prophet moderate automatic
XGBoost low via engineered features
LSTM lowest learned implicitly

Takeaway

LSTM captured the sharp rush-hour peaks most accurately, but at a real cost in training time and tuning effort — XGBoost with well-chosen lag and calendar features came close at a fraction of the compute, which matters when the model needs to be retrained regularly on fresh data.
